name: Cyber Dragon
description: A mechanical dragon built for battle. Fused with its own kind, it grows a second head, then a third.

name: Cyber Twin Dragon
description: Two Cyber Dragons joined into one. Its twin heads fire one blast after another.

name: Cyber End Dragon
description: A three-headed machine dragon of ultimate power. Its triple blast pierces any defense.

name: Arcana Knight Joker
description: The ace knight born when the King, Queen and Jack unite. It wields the power of every suit.

name: Valkyrion the Magna Warrior
description: The three Magnet Warriors joined into one. Magnetic force binds its body into an unbreakable shield.
fusions: Conduction Warrior Linear Magnum Plus Minus
Conduction Warrior Linear Magnum Plus Minus
Conduction Warrior Linear Magnum Plus Minus

name: Ancient Gear Megaton Golem
description: An ancient war machine rebuilt from countless gears. Each step it takes shakes the earth.

name: Super Conductor Tyranno
description: A dinosaur charged with lightning. Its bite carries a deadly electric shock.

name: Thunder Dragon Titan
description: The final form of the thunder dragons. Its body is a storm, and every roar calls down lightning.

name: Gladiator Beast Heraklinos
description: The champion of the gladiator beasts. It rules the arena with a mighty spear and blazing flames.

name: Volcanic Doomfire
description: A fiend born from the heart of a volcano. Its molten body burns all that stand before it.

name: Vampire Genesis
description: The first vampire, reborn from the Vampire Lord. It commands the undead from its coffin throne.

name: Horus the Black Flame Dragon LV8
description: The black flame dragon in its final form. Its dark fire can silence any spell.

name: VW-Tiger Catapult
description: A tiger jet and a catapult wing joined as one.

name: XY-Dragon Cannon
description: A cannon with a dragon head, firing from both ends.

name: XZ-Tank Cannon
description: A cannon mounted on a metal tank.

name: YZ-Tank Dragon
description: A dragon head on a metal tank.

name: XYZ-Dragon Cannon
description: Three machines united. Its triple attack destroys everything in its path.

name: VWXYZ-Dragon Catapult Cannon
description: Five combat machines united into one flying fortress. Its catapult cannon blasts any target away.

name: Dark Paladin
description: The dark knight born when the Dark Magician and Buster Blader join forces. Its sword slays dragons.

name: Spiral Serpent
description: A giant serpent that coils around the sea. It wraps its prey in its spiral body.

name: Simorgh, Bird of Ancestry
description: A sacred bird of legend that rules the sky. Its wings call down a storm.

name: Tytannial, Princess of Camellias
description: The princess of the camellia garden. Her blossoms bloom into a storm of petals.

name: Cloudian - Eye of the Typhoon
description: The king of the clouds. It sits in the eye of a typhoon and rules the storm.

name: Beast King Barbaros
description: The king of all beasts. Its roar alone puts a whole army to flight.

name: Ultimate Flame Swordsman
description: The flame swordsman at its peak, burning with more fire than ever. Its blade cuts through anything.

name: Red Dragon Archfiend
description: A crimson dragon of flame and darkness. Its Absolute Powerforce scorches all.

name: Black Luster Soldier - Envoy of the Beginning
description: The soldier who appears at the start of a battle. Its blade of light banishes any foe.

name: Armed Dragon LV7
description: A dragon with blades along its body. It slashes foes with blade wings.

name: Stardust Dragon
description: A shining dragon of the wind. It protects its allies from destruction.

name: Stardust Dragon/Assault Mode
description: Stardust Dragon in a battle form. Its wings blaze with starlight.

name: Perfect Machine King
description: The king of machines. Every machine on the field is powered up by its might.

name: The Masked Beast
description: A beast sealed behind a cursed mask. When the mask comes off, its fury is unstoppable.

name: Doom Dozer
description: A giant insect that bulldozes over everything. Nothing stands in its way.

name: Buster Blader
description: The swordsman who slays dragons. Gains 500 ATK for each face-up Dragon on the foe's side.

name: Dark Magician Girl
description: A girl who studied magic beside the Dark Magician. Gains 300 ATK for each Dark Magician or Magician of Black Chaos destroyed.

name: Dark Magician of Destruction
description: The Dark Magician reborn with a power of ruin.

name: Dark Magician the Dragon Knight
description: The dark magician who rides a dragon into battle. Together they strike as one.

name: King's Knight
description: The king of the card knights. When the queen stands beside him, the jack answers his call.

name: Queen's Knight
description: The queen of the card knights. Her grace commands the loyalty of the king and the jack.

name: Jack's Knight
description: The jack of the card knights. He serves the king and queen with a sharp blade.

name: Guardian Chimera
description: A beast of many bodies that guards the sacred ground. Its triple claws tear through all.

name: St. Joan
description: A holy maiden who leads armies into battle. Her faith turns the tide of every war.

name: Hyper-Ancient Shark Megalodon
description: A huge shark from the ancient seas. It bites through anything in its way.

name: Gagagigo the Risen
description: The lizard warrior who has risen again. His new strength comes from the pain he has felt.

name: Sphinx Teleia
description: The sphinx that guards the tomb. It asks a riddle, and no one has ever answered.

name: Obelisk the Tormentor
description: The giant god of the pharaoh. Its fists crush an enemy and its soul-energy blast wipes out all.

name: Slifer the Sky Dragon
description: ATK and DEF are 1000 for each card in your hand. Foe's Attack Position monsters lose 2000 ATK; at 0 they are destroyed.

name: The Winged Dragon of Ra
description: The winged dragon of the sun. Its ATK is its owner's life points.

name: Dark Master - Zorc
description: The dark master who rules the darkness of the Shadow Realm. Its wrath drains all light.

name: Andro Sphinx
description: The sphinx of the pyramid. It guards the pharaoh's tomb and punishes any thief.

name: Conduction Warrior Linear Magnum Plus Minus
description: Two magnet warriors joined by a surge of plus and minus. The current between them fuels a third.

name: Alligator's Sword
description: A swordsman with the head of an alligator. His blade bites hard.

name: Berfomet
description: A beast of the dark with the horns of a goat. It lurks in the shadows.

name: Cyber Ogre
description: A cyborg ogre built for war. It crushes its foes with sheer power.

name: Elemental HERO Neos
description: The hero who came from outer space. He joins with the Neo-Spacians.

name: Elemental HERO Avian
description: A hero of the wind with feathered wings. He glides over the battlefield.

name: Elemental HERO Burstinatrix
description: A hero of flame. She burns her foes with a blast of fire.

name: Elemental HERO Clayman
description: A hero made of clay. His sturdy body shrugs off any blow.

name: Elemental HERO Sparkman
description: A hero of light. He strikes with a lightning bolt.

name: Neo-Spacian Air Hummingbird
description: A hummingbird from space. It drifts through the sky and heals its friends.

name: Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin
description: A dolphin from space. It swims through the sea and guides the hero.

name: Neo-Spacian Dark Panther
description: A panther from space. It prowls the dark and copies a hero.

name: Neo-Spacian Flare Scarab
description: A scarab from space. Its body burns with a bright flame.

name: Neo-Spacian Grand Mole
description: A mole from space. It digs through the ground and shakes it.

name: Neo-Spacian Marine Dolphin
description: A marine dolphin from space. It guards the oceans.

name: Alligator's Sword Dragon
description: A dragon that fuses with an alligator swordsman. Its sword bites hard.

name: Blaze Fenix, the Burning Bombardment Bird
description: A firebird of metal and flame. It bombards its foes from the sky.

name: Chimera the Flying Mythical Beast
description: A beast of the sky that fuses with a goat fiend. It flies on two great wings.
fusions: Gazelle the King of Mythical Beasts

name: Chimera the Illusion Beast
description: A dark chimera born from illusion. It tricks all who face it.

name: Chimera the King of Phantom Beasts
description: The king of phantom beasts. It bares its fangs and rules the night.

name: Cyber Ogre 2
description: Two cyber ogres fused into one. Its mighty strength is twice as much.

name: Dragon Master Knight
description: The legendary knight who rides the ultimate dragon. His power is without equal.

name: Elemental HERO Absolute Zero
description: The hero of ice. He freezes the field and all that stands on it.

name: Elemental HERO Escuridao
description: The dark hero of the shadows. He swallows all in the dark.

name: Elemental HERO Gaia
description: The hero of the earth. He rises from the ground and crushes all.

name: Elemental HERO Great Tornado
description: The hero of the storm. He whirls up a great tornado that strips the foe.

name: Elemental HERO Nova Master
description: The hero of the flames. He burns with the power of a star.

name: Elemental HERO The Shining
description: The hero of light. He lights the field with a blinding flash.

name: Elemental HERO Air Neos
description: The Neos hero joined by the winged Neo-Spacian. He rides the wind.

name: Elemental HERO Aqua Neos
description: The Neos hero joined by the aqua Neo-Spacian. He sways the tides.

name: Elemental HERO Dark Neos
description: The Neos hero joined by the dark Neo-Spacian. He uses the dark.

name: Elemental HERO Flare Neos
description: The Neos hero joined by the flare Neo-Spacian. He burns bright.

name: Elemental HERO Grand Neos
description: The Neos hero joined by the grand Neo-Spacian. He shakes the earth.

name: Elemental HERO Marine Neos
description: The Neos hero joined by the marine Neo-Spacian. He rules the waves.

name: Elemental HERO Storm Neos
description: The Neos hero in the form of a storm. He joins air and water into a storm.

name: Elemental HERO Neos Knight
description: The Neos hero in a knight's armor. He fights with a holy sword.

name: Ryu Kokki
description: A fanged ghoul that drains the life of anything it bites.

name: Vampire Voivode
description: A vampire warlord who leads armies of the dead.

name: Doomking Balerdroch
description: A towering undead king whose roar shakes the grave.

name: Despair from the Dark
description: A hulking horror from the dark that crushes all hope.

name: Eldlich the Golden Lord
description: A lich king of gold who rules the dead from a golden throne.

name: Eldlich the Mad Golden Lord
description: The golden lich king gone mad. Every undead bows before it.

name: Roc from the Valley of Haze
description: A giant bird that carries off whatever it can lift.

name: Sacred Phoenix of Nephthys
description: A phoenix that burns itself away and rises again from the ashes.

name: Cyber Slash Harpie Lady
description: A cyber harpie with blades for wings. Her slash tears through anything in her path.

name: Sacred Fire King Garunix
description: A fire king in the shape of a bird. Its wings leave embers in the sky.

name: Windrose the Elemental Lord
description: A lord of the winds. It rides the storm with its wings spread wide.
fusions: Roc from the Valley of Haze
Roc from the Valley of Haze

name: Shinobaron Peacock
description: The great peacock of the ninja. Its feathers are blades.

name: Archfiend of Gilfer
description: A fiend that drags the souls of its foes into the dark.

name: Archfiend Giant
description: A giant fiend that shrugs off every blow.

name: Red-Eyes Black Dragon Exceed
description: The Red-Eyes Black Dragon pushed past its limit by the power of time.

name: Red-Eyes Black Metal Dragon
description: The Red-Eyes Black Dragon remade in black steel.

name: Archfiend Black Skull Dragon
description: A black skull dragon fused with an archfiend. Its breath burns the soul.

name: Red-Eyes Dark Dragoon
description: The Dark Magician joined with a dragon of great strength.

name: Red-Eyes Flare Metal Dragon
description: A red-eyed dragon in flame-forged armor.

name: Red-Eyes Slash Dragon
description: A red-eyed dragon that fights with a warrior's blade.

name: Red-Eyes Zombie Dragon Lord
description: The undead lord of the red-eyed dragons.

name: Dark Magician Girl the Dragon Knight
description: The Dark Magician Girl in dragon armor, riding a great dragon.

name: The Dark Magicians
description: The master and his apprentice cast side by side.

name: Lava Golem
description: A giant of molten rock, raised by the dead. It burns everything it touches.

name: Red-Eyes Baby Dragon
description: A small dragon with red eyes. Given time, it grows into a Red-Eyes Black Dragon.

name: Dark Necrofear
description: A fallen doll that lures its foes into the dark.

name: Vampire Lord
description: A lord of the night. It drinks the life of the living.

name: Zombie Master
description: A necromancer who calls the dead back to fight.

name: Gravekeeper's Assailant
description: A tomb guard who strikes from the shadows.

name: Gravekeeper's Guard
description: A tomb guard who turns away those who enter.

name: Gravekeeper's Spy
description: A tomb guard who watches the dead and the living.

name: Dark Magician of Chaos
description: The Dark Magician taken by chaos. Its spells bend the dead.

name: Mermaid Knight
description: A knight of the sea who rides the waves into battle.

name: Spirit of the Pharaoh
description: The spirit of a king who walks the tombs.

name: Mirage Dragon
description: A dragon of light that hides in the haze.

name: Skull Dog Marron
description: A hound of bone that guards the underworld.

name: Wall of Illusion
description: A wall that bends the minds of those who strike it.

name: Gil Garth
description: A dark knight with a heart as cold as his blade.

name: Five-Headed Dragon
description: Five dragons joined into one. It can only be made with Polymerization.

name: Blue-Eyes Tyrant Dragon
description: A blue-eyed dragon fused with another dragon. Its tyrant fury knows no limit.

name: Blue-Eyes Alternative White Dragon
description:

becomes "Blue-Eyes
White Dragon".
